title: A message from the landlord
instructions: Ev sahibi kiracısına sesli mesaj bırakıyor. Kısa ama her ayrıntı önemli. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: land
script.text: Hello Sara, it's Mr Brown, your landlord.

script.speaker: land
script.text: A man is coming to repair the heating on Tuesday, not Monday.

script.speaker: land
script.text: He'll be there between nine and eleven.

script.speaker: land
script.text: If you aren't at home, please leave the key with your neighbour, Mrs White.

script.speaker: land
script.text: Call me if there is a problem.
